FileHeader.rules: The header must be placed above imports and must contain the absolute or relative file path to facilitate AI context.

ClassDescription.rules: The class description must explain the component's responsibility and its place in the application hierarchy.

FunctionDescription.rules: Describe the 'WHY' and 'HOW' (the logic), not the 'WHAT' (which is visible from the name). For getters, always describe the fallback logic.

language: All descriptions and comments must be in English only
